full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Fazlul Karim, J:  This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the impugned judgment and order of the High Court Division summarily rejecting the application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure against the judgment and order No. 192 dated 01.04.1985 passed by the Subordinate Judge, First Court Narsingdi in Title Suit No. 10 of 1999 rejecting the application under order 7 rule 11 of the Code of Civil for rejecting the plaint in the partition suit on the ground that the plaintiff being out of possession of the suit land, the suit of the partition is not maintainable. 

 "Mr. Harnid fails to satisfy this court producing any material that the plaintiff is really out of possession, he is not a co-sharer find that the partition suit is maintainable because the plaintiff already established at least a prima facie case that he is a bonafide purchaser by registered document of certain portion of the suit holding from a co sharer. Therefore he has every right to file the present suit and the petitioner has already filed written statement but the plaintiff must prove his title before setting a decree as in a suit for partition title also can be decided by the parties."
